name: cca
description: Contract Capsule Authorization — control plane, PDP, compiler, and console
author: Manish Kumar

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cca/core && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cca/api" "npm run dev -w @cca/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cca/core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @cca/core && npm run test -w @cca/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cca/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.preflight: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
